title: Corso: government panic over UFOs at New Mexico V-2 and nuclear sites

tellings.quote: And if you read Philip Corso's The Day After Roswell, the US government went into panic mode because they started seeing a lot of them down in New Mexico where they were testing the V-2 rockets,

plain: Around 1947 the US government "went into panic mode" because many UFOs were being seen over New Mexico, where the military was testing captured German V-2 rockets and working on nuclear weapons. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels this from The Day After Roswell, a book published in 1997 by Philip Corso, a former Army officer, and named after the reported 1947 crash of a craft near Roswell, New Mexico. If true, the craft were drawn to America's most secret weapons sites.
